claims.assertion: Anéeka distinguishes Procyonians from Procyon, human-looking Federation members, from Proceon residents, who are Taygetans of the same race and culture.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She treats the similar names as distinct.

claims.assertion: She describes Procyon as a binary system with seven planets, two inhabited; its 5D human-looking inhabitants have a holistic-patriarchal polity and positive ties to Alcyone.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka says sulfuric atmospheres may host advanced silicon-based, insectoid or mollusk-like beings with exoskeletons; she describes them as mutually respectful but poorly compatible.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says the societies do not understand each other well.
